purpose: Deterministic tools executed by the Harness around the Skill action; these are not child_tools.

tools.purpose: Validate structured resume content, persist canonical JSON, render a safe single-column HTML resume, and return its artifact reference.
tools.trigger: The tailored-resume-generator Skill returns outcome success with a tailored_resume object.
steps: Validate the returned tailored_resume schema and require source_refs on every resume bullet.
Persist canonical JSON in the authenticated action artifact workspace.
Render an escaped single-column HTML resume without audit-only notes in the resume body.
Verify and index the artifact, then return artifact_ref and publication status.

tailored_resume.description: Validated structured resume content returned by the Skill.

artifact_ref.description: Opaque artifact reference for the generated resume.
